betaReleaseNotes: Star-AI 4.0 has been temporarily locked due to a bug.
releaseNotes: Added modern Liquid Glass visual effects.
Added Blur and Liquid Glass customization options.
Added global animation controls to enable or disable animations.
Improved button interactions, menus, pop-ups, and window transitions.
Added smooth animations for interface elements.
Redesigned the AI version selector with a compact dropdown menu.
Added visual indicators for locked and available AI versions.
Improved Persian language support across the application.
Added Persian translations to the Help section.
Improved language consistency throughout the interface.
Fixed version selector positioning and dropdown behavior.
Improved overall UI stability and user experience.
